title: Figure 26: THz properties of an electric split ring resonator
description: Five-panel figure: (a) split ring resonator geometry with labeled dimensions, (b) equivalent circuit schematic with R, L, C, (c) 3D view of a resonator array with Ohmic and Schottky contacts and bias, (d) cross-section of the split gap showing depletion in n-GaAs on SI-GaAs, and (e) an incident and transmitted THz beam passing through the device. Caption: "Figure 26. THz Properties of an Electric Split Ring Resonator." Below are the highlighted "Summary and Conclusions" and the start of the References list.
